message: Running command: grep -n "GetEntry\|GetNumEntries\|class HasRouteTlv\|class HasRouteEntry" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/src/core/thread/network_data_tlvs.hpp | head -30

message.content:
Now I can see the vulnerability. In `AddHasRoute`, the code does:
```cpp
memcpy(dstHasRoute->GetEntry(dstHasRoute->GetNumEntries() - 1), aHasRoute.GetEntry(0), sizeof(HasRouteEntry));
```

This copies `sizeof(HasRouteEntry)` bytes from `aHasRoute.GetEntry(0)` - but if `aHasRoute` has 0 entries, `GetEntry(0)` reads out of bounds. Let me look at the `GetEntry` function and the `HasRouteTlv` structure.
